purpose: 3-parameter Stinespring coefficient model. Iteration 29 Strang dt² correction reduced composite error to 0.074% but Stinespring coefficient model a_F(dt) = a_F0 + a_F1*dt remained the bottleneck (component error 0.113%). Analysis revealed a_F(dt) is non-monotonic (peak at dt~0.8), requiring 3-parameter model: a_F(dt) = a_F0 + a_F1*dt + a_F2*dt² (LOO-validated, not overfitting). This iteration adds: (1) 3-param Stinespring model + LOO validation, (2) M7 model variant (Stine-3param + Strang-dt² + cos(dt²)), (3) M7 Rate(d_F) prediction, (4) additional dt points for validation.
simulator_note: ST uses symmetric (palindromic) Lindblad product ordering. SCPT uses the same palindromic ordering with exact channel exponentials.
